newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CHARIOT RIDES WAVE OF FEDERAL-MOGUL RUMOURS.
newsitem.headline: CHARIOT RIDES WAVE OF FEDERAL-MOGUL RUMOURS.

text.p: Shares in South African motor industry firm Chariot Holdings Ltd had a roller-coaster morning on Monday as they rode a rumour mill over a possible U.S.-related buy, dealers said.
The firm is thought to be at the head of a race to strike a deal with Federal-Mogul SA, the South African unit of U.S. vehicle spares firm Federal-Mogul Corp .
Federal-Mogul SA said in February it aimed to sell its wholesale and retail segments as it wants to focus on its engineering, manufacturing and distributing operations.
"The rumour is that they have, or are about to, win the Federal-Mogul deal," one dealer said.

Chariot shares hit a new year high of 122 cents in morning trade before falling back to 115 cents, a gain gf two cents at 1015 GMT. Volumes were heavy with more than 2.4 million shares changing hands in over 200 separate trades.
Analysts said the share's volatility was due to nothing having yet been confirmed about the possible buy. "It is all just speculation," one dealer said.
